name: mcp-postgres
description: Read-only PostgreSQL introspection and query server for Claude. Exposes schemas, tables, views, functions, triggers; runs safe SELECT/WITH queries; profiles plans with EXPLAIN ANALYZE; surfaces table stats.
long_description: Read-only PostgreSQL MCP server with 13 tools (introspection + querying + EXPLAIN + table stats), 2 resource templates (schema and table URIs) and 4 prompts (audit-table, find-tables, explain-foreign-keys, profile-slow-query). All queries run in READ ONLY transactions with a 30s statement_timeout and a 100-row cap. Multi-statement input is rejected.

db_user.title: User
db_user.description: Database user. A read-only role is recommended.

db_ssl.title: Enable SSL
db_ssl.description: Set to 'true' for cloud databases (AWS RDS, Supabase, Neon...).

db_ssl_reject_unauthorized.title: Reject unauthorized SSL certs
db_ssl_reject_unauthorized.description: Keep 'true' in production. Set 'false' only for self-signed certs.

db_schemas.title: Allowed schemas
db_schemas.description: Comma-separated list of schemas to expose. Empty = all non-system schemas.

tools.name: postgres_describe_table
tools.description: Columns, constraints and indexes of a table.

tools.name: postgres_search_columns
tools.description: Search columns by name across allowed schemas.

tools.name: postgres_query_table
tools.description: Safe single-table SELECT with structured filters.

tools.name: postgres_explain_query
tools.description: EXPLAIN or EXPLAIN ANALYZE for a SELECT/WITH.

tools.name: postgres_get_table_stats
tools.description: Storage footprint and activity stats for a table.
